about: Release-policy template (W-42). release.sh policy sign fills policy_id, signed_at and expires_at, merges paths.json, and signs the result. allow names Tekton pipelines; anything not listed waits for the Owner. Every condition must hold for platform-api to approve a tier-C release without the Owner. trust_anchor_reviewed (Owner 2026-11-14, ci-speed/owner-off-the-loop-rules.md class 3): a no_trust_anchor_change hit in a reviewable_repos repository is covered when a session that authored none of the commits recorded a passed review of exactly that commit naming every trust-anchor file of the diff (record_release_review); trust_anchor_ignore_tests leaves _test.go and testdata out of what must be reviewed. apply (class 4): an apply_manifest plan is covered when every object is one of these kinds in these namespaces, already exists with an Apply entry of field_manager (so the same path at an earlier commit of main is the way back), and neither its path nor any object is excluded; everything else waits for the Owner. Owner 10-08: no rolling cap; reminders 14d, 3d and 1d before expiry.
